source_parts: It seems to be the first time you connect to this server:The remote server identity is not yet known by MobaXterm.Press "Accept" if you trust this identity and want to carry on connecting.Press "Cancel" if you want to abandon this connection.
target_parts: 这似乎是您首次连接到此服务器：MobaXterm 尚未识别此远程服务器的身份。如果您信任此身份并希望继续连接，请点击“接受”。若要放弃此次连接，请点击“取消”。

source_parts: Warning: remote server identity has changed!The SFTP server identity has changed since last connection.This means that either the server host key has changed (after a new server installation or upgrade), or you have actually connected to another computer pretending to be the server.Do you want to accept this new identity and carry on connecting?
target_parts: 警告：远程服务器身份已变更！SFTP 服务器的身份与上次连接时不同。这可能是服务器重新安装或升级后主机密钥发生了变更，也可能是您实际连接到了冒充该服务器的另一台计算机。是否接受此新身份并继续连接？

source_parts: No smart card certificate found.Click on the right green button to create a new smart card certificate.Important: you must have a smart card that is compatible with the PIV(Personal Identity Verification) interface, and have write access to it.For Yubikey smart cards, you must have the Yubikey minidriver installed.

source_parts: The master password is your personal password which is used to encrypt your MobaXterm stored passwords database.
This master password has been set on
on this computer with this Windows account.
Go to MobaXterm global settings --> "MobaXterm passwords management" --> "Master password settings".
You will be prompted for your Windows password and then, you will be able to set another master password.
If your master password is definitely lost, you can download the "Reset Master Password" tool from our website: https://mobaxterm.mobatek.net/resetmasterpassword.html.
It will delete the master password and all the stored passwords as well, and allow you to start MobaXterm again.
